retrievalProfile.description: A high-key minimalist layout featuring a floating subject with directional motion blur and a mix of organic and geometric typography.
excludeWhen: dark or moody lighting is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A central figure appears to float or fall diagonally across a bright white void, captured with intentional motion blur to suggest speed. The lower left quadrant contains a tiered typographic block that balances the weight of the subject.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal subject line vs. horizontal text baseline
High-contrast dark clothing against a blown-out white background
Sharp typographic lines vs. soft motion-blurred imagery
Asymmetrical balance between the subject in the top right and text in the bottom left
coreInvariants: Motion blur on the subject's extremities
Diagonal orientation of the main figure

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the top right two-thirds of the frame, angled at approximately 30 degrees.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark torso of the subject acts as the primary anchor, with the text block serving as a secondary weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the subject's diagonal line from top-left to bottom-right, then drops to the text block in the lower left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space in the bottom right and around the text creates a sense of airiness and 'gravity-free' environment.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, high contrast; saturation is low except for the warm wood tones of the instrument.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to monochromatic tones with one warm accent

letterConstructionRules: Top line: Rough, hand-drawn texture with varying stroke widths and organic terminals.
Bottom lines: Ultra-thin geometric strokes with open counters and extended descenders.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'y' features an exaggerated, long diagonal descender that cuts through the negative space.
The 'g' uses a simplified, open-loop geometric construction.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between organic/heavy and geometric/light weights.
graphicDevices: Exaggerated descender on the final word to create a vertical anchor.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the hand-drawn, slightly irregular feel of the primary display text.
Provides the clean, geometric skeleton needed for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key photo of a person in dark clothing floating diagonally across a pure white frame. Apply a directional motion blur (zoom or linear) to the limbs and instrument to suggest movement while keeping the face relatively clear.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply the primary text in a hand-drawn black sans-serif in the middle-left. Below it, stack the secondary text in a hairline geometric sans-serif, ensuring the 'y' descender is elongated to reach toward the bottom edge.

verificationChecks: Does the subject have visible motion blur?
Is the text block left-aligned and positioned in the lower-left quadrant?
Is there a clear weight contrast between the two font styles?

mustRedesign: Avoid using the specific artist's name or likeness
Do not replicate the exact guitar model
Ensure the hand-drawn font is a new creation or licensed alternative
postGenerationChecks: Check for 'floating' effect vs 'lying down' effect
Verify motion blur direction matches the diagonal axis
Ensure text is legible against the white background
Confirm the 'y' descender doesn't overlap other critical elements
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key background + Diagonal blurred subject + Mixed-weight left-aligned typography = Dynamic Minimalist Cover
